headline: Gunther von Hagens, Creator of Polarizing ‘Body Worlds’ Exhibits, Dies at 81
context: A German scientist, he developed a process for turning corpses into posable figures. His shows drew millions of visitors, and many detractors.

sources.name: The New York Times
